listIntro: Requests you sent and requests you follow, with their latest status and who has them now

filter.searchHint: Part of it is enough, e.g. 00012
filter.limited: Showing the newest {shown}. Search by document number or choose a status to find older requests.
filter.scopeFollowing: Your requests and the ones you follow, without drafts
filter.infoOpen: Only requests with an approver's question waiting for your answer
filter.label: Request filters

emptyNoneHint: Press Buy or hire, choose a request type and fill it in step by step. Requests you send appear here with their latest status.
emptyNoMatchHint: Type the full document number, or clear the filters to see all your requests.

stage.DRAFT: Not sent yet. Edit it and send it when ready
stage.ANSWER_MINE: Waiting for your answer to the approver’s question
stage.ANSWER: Waiting for the requester to answer the approver’s question
stage.REQUESTER_EDIT_MINE: Waiting for you to edit and send it again
stage.REQUESTER_EDIT: Waiting for the requester to edit and send it again
stage.PROCUREMENT: Waiting for procurement to issue a purchase order
stage.QUEUE: Waiting for procurement to add this supplier
stage.REVIEWERS: Waiting for {name} to review it before the approver

waiting.hours: Waiting {hours, plural, one {# business hour} other {# business hours}}
waiting.minutes: Waiting {minutes, plural, one {# business minute} other {# business minutes}}

detail.forbidden: You may not view this request
detail.forbiddenHint: If you need to see this request, contact its requester or your organization’s administrator.

amounts.title: Amounts
amounts.notYet: VAT, the total and the approval route are worked out when the request is sent

budget.title: Budget
budget.stateCommitted: Budget held by a purchase order
budget.none: No budget line chosen yet; the department’s line is used when the request is sent
budget.splitNote: This request splits its cost over several budget lines. Its approvers come from the department with the largest share.

route.title: Approval route
route.round: Round {no}: worked out again when it was sent again, under the DOA in effect at that time
route.firstDecides: Whoever decides first decides this step
route.escalated: Escalated when overdue: the next approval level joined
route.notYet: The approval route is worked out when the request is sent, then shown here with the reason
route.none: This request type does not go through the DOA; it goes straight to procurement

explain.subject: a {document} of {amount} baht ({basis})
explain.bandBetween: is in the band above {lower} up to {upper}
explain.bandUpTo: is in the band up to {upper}
explain.escalated: the approver of rule {from} is part of this document, so it moves to rule {rule} of the next band

route.reviewProgress: {done} of {total} passed; all must pass before the approver
route.holderChanged: The holder of the position changed after the request was sent, so this step went to the current holder under the same DOA rule

lines.title: Lines
lines.none: No lines yet; add them on the edit page

quotes.title: Quotations
quotes.nonLowest: Why the lowest quotation was not chosen

files.title: Attachments
files.failed: {name} could not be opened. It may have been removed or you may not open it. Reload the page and try again.

noLongerNeeded.STEP_DECIDED: No answer needed: this step was decided

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.label: Timeline of the request

what.WAIT_REQUESTER_EDIT: Waiting for the requester to edit and send again
what.WAIT_PROCUREMENT: Waiting for procurement to issue a purchase order
what.WAIT_QUEUE: Waiting for procurement to add the supplier

timeline.escalated: This step was escalated when overdue

actions.title: What to do
actions.answerTitle: The approver asked for more information
actions.answerHint: The approver is told, and the task goes back to the same approver with the time it had left
actions.answerSubmit: Send the answer to the approver
actions.returnedTitle: The approver returned it for changes
actions.editDraft: Edit the draft and send it for approval
actions.draftTitle: This request is still a draft
actions.draftHint: A draft has not reached any approver. Complete it and send it for approval from the edit page.
actions.resubmitHint: Press Edit the request, then check the budget left, the new approval route and the documents to attach on its Check and send step before you press Send for approval again.
actions.cancelHint: The reserved budget is given back at once and open approval tasks are closed
actions.cancelConfirm: I want to cancel this request and understand it cannot be undone
actions.reorderHint: Makes a new draft with the lines and answers the current form still asks. Check and change the draft, then send it for approval from the edit page. Files, quotations and the budget line are not copied.
actions.renewHint: Makes a new draft from a service line before it ends. Check and change the draft, give the new service end date, then send it for approval from the edit page.
actions.renewList: Service lines that can be renewed

errors.STATE: This request is no longer in a state that allows this. Reload the page to see its latest status.
errors.REASON: Give a reason of at least 3 characters
errors.CONFIRM: Tick the box first, because this cannot be undone
errors.FORBIDDEN: You cannot do this: the signed-in account is not this request's requester or no longer has this right. Reload the page to see your current rights; if you still cannot, ask your organization's administrator to check your account's roles.
errors.BUDGET_INSUFFICIENT: Not enough budget: {available} baht left, {shortfall} baht short. Change the amount or choose another budget line, then send again.
errors.BUDGET_LINE_CLOSED: This budget line is frozen or closed. Choose another line on the edit page, then send again.
errors.BUDGET_LINE: No budget line is chosen. Choose one on the edit page, then send again.
errors.ATTACHMENT: Attachments do not meet rule {rule} yet. Attach them on the edit page, then send again.
errors.FORM: The request is not complete. Complete it on the edit page, then send again.
errors.DOA_NOT_CONFIGURED: No DOA is in effect for this request. Contact your administrator.
errors.APPROVER_NOT_FOUND: No approver could be found under the DOA. Ask your administrator to check who holds the positions.
errors.NO_HIGHER_AUTHORITY: The DOA has nobody above the requester for this amount. Contact your administrator.
errors.TAX_RATE: There is no VAT rate for today. Contact your administrator.
errors.TYPE_INACTIVE: A new draft cannot be made from this request: the organization no longer offers its request type. Start a new request with Buy or hire.
errors.NOT_A_SERVICE_LINE: This line has no service end date, so it cannot be renewed. Use Ask again to ask for the whole request again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This request or question is no longer there. Reload the page.
errors.BUSY: Someone is working on this request right now. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.CONFLICT: This was already sent with different details. Reload the page and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again and retry.
errors.INTERNAL: It could not be saved because of a system error (reference {requestId}). Try again, or tell your administrator this reference.
errors.NO_ANSWER: No answer came back, perhaps because of the connection. Check it and press the same button again; it is done only once.
errors.FAILED: It could not be saved. Try again, or tell your administrator.

followers.title: Followers ({n})
followers.emptyRequester: No followers yet. Add colleagues who need to know how this request ends below.
followers.addHint: Followers are told when the request is approved, returned or not approved · only people who can already see this request can be chosen
followers.noCandidates: No member who can see this request is left to add
followers.added: {name} now follows this request and has been told

errors.NO_ANSWER: No answer came back. Press again; it will be done only once
errors.CANNOT_VIEW: This member cannot see the request yet, so they cannot follow it
errors.TOO_MANY: This request has as many followers as it can take. Remove someone first
errors.STATE: The followers changed meanwhile. Reload the page to see the latest list
errors.FORBIDDEN: You may not do this on this request
errors.FAILED: That did not work. Try again

followers.unfollowBody: You can see this request only because you follow it. If you stop, you can no longer open it and cannot follow it again yourself; the requester would have to add you
